skills.skill: Compare and order decimal numbers up to thousandths
Round a decimal number to the nearest hundredth

misconceptions.pattern: Thinks a decimal with more digits is larger (e.g. 2.475 > 2.5 because 475 > 5), comparing the fractional part as a whole number instead of place by place.
Drops the thousandths digit instead of rounding to the nearest hundredth (e.g. 2.475 answered 2.47 rather than 2.48).

strategies.intent: Give both numbers the same number of decimal places (pad with zeros), then compare place by place from the largest place down.
Look at the thousandths digit: 5 or more rounds the hundredth up, less than 5 keeps it; then drop the thousandths.
